svg.title: Transaction boundaries when a plug-in triggers another operation
svg.desc: The outer operation is an Update of a Cedar work order at depth 1. Its PreValidation stage runs outside the transaction; PreOperation, MainOperation and PostOperation run inside it. In PostOperation the plug-in creates a note. That Create of annotation is a second, nested pipeline at depth 2 with its own four stages, and all of them, including its PreValidation, run inside the outer transaction. Three outcomes: if every synchronous step succeeds, the work order change and the note commit together; if any synchronous step in either pipeline throws, both are rolled back and the caller receives the error; if an asynchronous step fails after the commit, the system job is marked Failed and the data stays saved.
svg.text: A nested operation joins the transaction of the plug-in that started it
Even PreValidation is inside the transaction here, because the outer plug-in started this operation.
Check context.IsInTransaction instead of assuming from the stage name.
Commit: Scheduled for change and the reschedule note are saved together, then the caller gets its response.
Any synchronous step throws, in the outer or the nested pipeline
Rollback: no work order change, no note. The caller receives the error. Trace log rows survive for diagnosis.
An asynchronous step fails after the commit
System job status Failed with the message. The saved data stays; an async step can never cancel the operation.
